===
path: Authentication > Login
name: Login
curl:
curl --location '{{APIGateway}}/login' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "username": "YOUR_USERNAME",
    "password": "YOUR_PASSWORD",
    "trace": false
}'
sampleResponse:
{ "success": true, "message": "Login Successful.", "data": { "token": "YOUR_LOGIN_TOKEN", "sessionid": "YOUR_ARM_SESSION", "changepassword": false, "expiry": "18000000", "appname": "ghcmrun", "roles": "default" }, "statuscode": 200, "statusdescription": "OK" }
test:
let bodydata = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pm.response.json()));
sessionid = bodydata.data.sessionid;
pm.globals.set('session', bodydata.data.sessionid);
token = bodydata.data.token;
pm.globals.set('token', bodydata.data.token);
console.log(token);
===
path: Authentication > Refresh Session
name: Refresh Session
curl:
curl --location '{{APIGateway}}/RefreshSession' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \
--data '{
    "armsessionid": "{{session}}"
}'
sampleResponse:
{ "success": true, "message": "", "data": { "token": "YOUR_LOGIN_TOKEN", "sessionid": "YOUR_UPDATED_ARM_SESSION", "changepassword": false, "expiry": "18000000", "trace": "" }, "statuscode": 200, "statusdescription": "OK", "trace": "", "tracefilepath": "" }
===
path: Authentication > Logout
name: Logout
curl:
curl --location '{{APIGateway}}/Logout' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \
--data '{
    "armsessionid": "{{session}}"
}'
sampleResponse:
{ "success": true, "message": "User SignOut Successful", "statuscode": 200, "statusdescription": "OK", "trace": "", "tracefilepath": "" }
===
path: Authentication > Login SSO
name: Login SSO
curl:
curl --location '{{APIGateway}}/loginsso' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \
--data '{
    "trace" : false
}'
===
path: Authentication > Logout SSO
name: Logout SSO
curl:
curl --location '{{APIGateway}}/logoutsso' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{token}}' \
--data '{
        "trace": false
   }'
===
path: Authentication > Client Login
name: Client Login
curl:
curl --location '{{Global_SSO_URI}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
--data-urlencode 'grant_type=client_credentials' \
--data-urlencode 'client_Id=YOUR_CLIENT_ID' \
--data-urlencode 'client_Secret=YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET' \
--data-urlencode 'scope=AxpertHCM' \
--data-urlencode 'username=YOUR_USERNAME' \
--data-urlencode 'password=YOUR_PASSWORD'
===
